item.tib: ye shes thig le gzhi'i 'grel pa
item.coloph: sgom 'grel don 'dus rgyal rigs kyi gshen po mi lus bsam legs kyis gsungs pa rdzogs so
item.note: the fol. no. 72 is used twice. this text is a commentary on the gzhi ye sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud. it was revealed by gu-ru rnon-rtse (b. 1136) at dung-phor of rta-nag (see karmay, treasury, pp. 166-167). in the tbmc edition (1971), the contents are divided and provided with separate titles. here in our text, all the contents are contained under one title.
